summary: Sky Quarry Inc. filed a Prospectus Supplement (424B5) to amend its at-the-market (ATM) equity sales agreement, replacing Cantor Fitzgerald with Muriel Siebert as sole sales agent and increasing the aggregate offering amount from $4.7M to $12.6M of common stock. The filing is a routine shelf takedown update, not a special situation event. No price per share, premium, or deal terms are specified; sales occur at market prices. The company remains listed on Nasdaq under symbol SKYQ. No board recommendation, advisor, or strategic transaction is involved. The filing merely reflects an ATM program adjustment and ongoing capital raising.
